ja269:1.1: Na hi vaṇṇena sampannā mañjukā piyadassanā kharavācā piyā honti asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
ja269:2.1: Nanu passas' imaṃ kāḷiṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ tilakāhataṃ kokilaṃ saṇhabhāṇena bahunnaṃ pāṇinaṃ piyaṃ.
ja269:3.1: Tāsmāsakhilavāc' assa mantabhāṇī anuddhato (Dhp. v..) atthaṃ dhammañ ca dīpeti madhuraṃ tassa bhāsitan ti.
